final_text:
Job J-2214 was not released. Both doors were coated, but neither has a passing QC record, so this is not a pass to run SB-2 unattended.

Both panels got one full raster of PU-9 (lot 26-596): 400 mm/s, 120 ml/min, pitch 20 mm, standoff 100 mm, margin 80 mm, 142 ml each, no sag. Before the clock ran out, 2214-1 read 91–95 µm at the five QC points and 87–95 µm at nearby edge checks (spec 80–120 µm). 2214-2 was sprayed the same way, but it was still inside the 60 s flash-off when robot time hit 11:40 and the robot locked, so `qc measure` could not be recorded. `station submit` at 11:44: 0 of 2 panels passed, job not released. About 177 ml remains in the pot.

I used too much of the 12 minutes on test-card setup and did not leave time for flash-off and QC. Do not add another coat unless a later reading is low; 2214-1 is already mid-spec, and more wet film risks runs or going over 120 µm. If the booth is reset, flash off 2214-2 and QC both panels before any rework.
